summary: Backend-only iteration_4 testing of the OEM stock-search performance fix. Verified the variant list cap (max 3, 8-char prefix removed) for all 7 ticket cases, confirmed VARIANT_SOURCES = {'fadpro'} is wired into server.py, measured the end-to-end /api/oem-stock-search wall-time at 5.12 s on a cold-cache cold-path call (well below the 50 s acceptance budget and the 45 s asyncio.wait_for global timeout), and validated the cache invariant — only source='fadpro' rows hold matched_variant != ref, zero copia/partspro mismatches.

action_items: No fix required — performance ticket is GREEN. Wall-time 5.12 s ≪ 50 s budget.
critical_code_review_comments: cached_supplier_search is still defined INSIDE the endpoint coroutine (~line 1163 in server.py) which makes VARIANT_SOURCES unimportable from tests. Test had to use source-string inspection. Hoisting to module scope would simplify unit testing.
server.py is 1639 lines — out of scope to refactor this iteration but the size warrants splitting catalog/oem/admin routers.

lookup() inside /api/oem-stock-search fires fadpro+copia+partspro in parallel per candidate via asyncio.gather. The FadPro path now does up to 3 sequential variant calls (3 s each = 9 s worst-case) while Copia/PartsPro are single-shot (5 s each). With Semaphore-bounded concurrency this fits comfortably in the 45 s global budget — confirmed live at 5.12 s.

The 'global timeout' log line we found in backend.err.log is historical (from the iteration_3 multi-variant regression) — it did NOT recur during this run; items=11 returned proves the global wait_for completed normally.
supplier_lookup_cache schema is consistent post-fix: every row now carries matched_variant + items + fetched_at.

Cold-cache wall-time for q='chaine,distribution' (model_id=39023, vehicle CITROËN BERLINGO K9, VIN VR7EF9HNAKJ575626) is 5.12 s on a freshly flushed cache. VARIANT_SOURCES={'fadpro'} hard-codes the variant-fallback to FadPro only. The 1608745980 FadPro regression case from iteration_2 was not produced by this query's candidate set, but the same mechanism is demonstrated by 4 other fadpro rows (1145953→114595, 9807238580→980723, 9823954880→982395, 9830301180→983030). Tests written: /app/backend/tests/test_oem_walltime_iteration4.py (14 pass + 1 skip in ~18 s).
rca_of_the_issue: RCA: iteration_3 introduced a 4-variant fadpro fallback that was ALSO running on Copia & PartsPro, both of which hold a per-supplier asyncio.Lock (iis_supplier_client.py line 133: 'async with self._lock'). With ~25 concurrent candidates × 3-4 variants × serialised lock = total wall-time > 100 s, tripping Cloudflare 524. iteration_4 fix: (1) hard-cap oem_search_variants to 3 entries and drop the 8-char prefix (was a marginal-utility middle variant); (2) gate the variant loop behind VARIANT_SOURCES={'fadpro'} so Copia/PartsPro now do exactly one search call each; (3) per-variant timeout 3 s for FadPro (3 calls × 3 s = 9 s worst-case) and 5 s single-shot for Copia/PartsPro; (4) tightened global asyncio.wait_for from 60 s → 45 s. Measured cold-cache wall-time after fix: 5.12 s (20x safety margin under Cloudflare 100 s). Cache invariants hold: zero copia/partspro variant mismatches, four legitimate fadpro fallback picks per the timed run.
